# Shipwright Studio

> Shipwright Studio is an independent engineering studio crafting websites, web apps, and AI infrastructure for startups and small teams. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, working worldwide. Founded and run by a senior software engineer.

## Services

- **Custom website development**: Fast, accessible, search-friendly marketing sites and landing pages. Modern stack, no bloated templates.
- **Web application development**: Interactive dashboards, internal tools, and customer-facing apps — designed, engineered, and deployed end to end.
- **AI infrastructure**: LLM application engineering, inference cost optimization, GPU communication and distributed training performance.

## Selected work

- **Lumen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lumen/): An interactive photography lab that teaches the exposure triangle (aperture, shutter speed, ISO) with real-time canvas simulations of depth of field, motion blur, noise, and light metering.
- **Forge** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/forge/): An LLM inference cost estimator. Enter model size, quantization, GPU type, batch size, and traffic to estimate GPU count, latency, and monthly serving cost.
- **The Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/ideas/): An open bank of 112 web experiments — games, developer tools, browser extension prototypes, and small apps. Two new experiments are designed, built, and shipped every day. Recent additions: **Date Night Generator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/date-night/), a free online date night planner — pick a vibe, a budget and how much time you have, and get a complete three-step evening plan with timings, shuffle and surprise-me, all in the browser, **Screen Picker** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/eyedropper/), a free online screen colour picker — sample any colour with the browser EyeDropper or enter a hex, with live HEX, RGB, HSL and CSS-variable conversion and one-click copy, all computed locally, **Orb Eater** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/orb-eater/), a free online agar-style arena game — steer your orb through a petri dish, eat pellets and smaller rivals to grow, dodge bigger ones, with three difficulty levels and a local best score, all in the browser, **robots.txt Builder** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/robots-builder/), a free online robots.txt builder — click together crawler rules with presets, live file preview and validation, then copy or download the finished file, all computed locally, **Band Name Gen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/band-names/), a free online band name generator — one click for a name with genre filters, style modes, favourites and a daily name, all in the browser, **Markdown Clipper** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/markdown-clipper/), a free online HTML-to-Markdown converter — paste HTML to get clean Markdown with live preview, copy and .md download, all computed locally, **Mini Tower Defense** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/tower-defense/), a free online tower defense game — place arrow, cannon and frost towers along a serpentine path, survive 20 escalating waves, upgrade and sell towers, with wave previews and local best-wave tracking, all in the browser, **Barcode Gen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/barcode-generator/), a free online Code 128 barcode generator — type any text to render a crisp barcode with checksum, human-readable text toggle, size and colour controls, and PNG/SVG download, all computed locally, **Reading Mode** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/reading-mode/), a free online reading mode tool — strip any article to clean text, try it on three cluttered samples or paste your own HTML, with reading time, word count and typography controls, all in the browser, **Web3 Glossary Flashcards** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/web3-flashcards/), a free online flip-card study game — learn 40 essential crypto and web3 terms with plain-English definitions, Know / Still-learning piles, category filters and a review mode for missed terms, all in the browser, **Startup Idea Generator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/startup-generator/), a free online startup idea generator — roll audience, problem, technology, business model and twist into a named startup pitch, with per-slot locks, favourites, history and a self-referential meta mode, all in the browser, **Bitcoin Halving Countdown** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/block-countdown/), a free online Bitcoin halving countdown — blocks remaining to block 1,050,000, estimated halving date, epoch progress and reward schedule, estimates from a stated block-height anchor, all in the browser,
